helpStart: Choose a hero, then pick Story or Explore the Nine Lands.
helpCard: Tap a card to see its effect and available actions.
helpTurn: On your turn, play cards and attack. End your turn when you are done.
helpWin: Usually, you win by reducing your opponent's Life to zero. Check Objectives for special stages.
helpRules: Cards may have costs and use limits. Open Full Rules when you need the details.
helpSave: Your progress is saved in this browser. Export a backup before clearing its data.
availableDemo: Play as six heroes from Taiwan, Egypt and the Norse lands.
lockedDemo: Other lands and the Netherworld are previews for now.
partial: Some text is not translated yet and appears in Traditional Chinese.
packError: The language pack could not load. Please try again.
voiceUnavailable: Story voice is not available in this language yet. You can read the subtitles.
saveFolder: Choose a folder for your battle records.
guideVoice: Choose a hero. Tap a card to see what you can do. Check the stage objective, and end your turn when you are done.
localePreferenceError: Language applied, but settings could not be saved. The previous setting may return next time.
expReward.afterWinExplanation: This card only determines the encounter. Choose your reward separately after winning.
expReward.fixedGift: First-clear bonus: {card} ×{count}. Its inventory space is reserved.
expReward.chooseAfterWin: Choose one reward card. Your final confirmed choice applies; selecting a card does not add it to your collection yet.
expReward.encounterExplanation: Before battle, choose the encounter card. It only affects the enemy setup; choose your reward separately after winning.
expReward.settleFull: Eligible cards are full: settle result
expReward.fullCapacity: All eligible cards are at the holding limit. Confirm to settle this battle; any first-clear bonus shown above is still granted.
expReward.fullPool: All eligible cards from this land are at the holding limit.
expReward.alreadyClaimed: This battle’s reward has already been claimed. It will not be granted twice.
expReward.settledFull: Battle settled. All eligible cards are at the holding limit.
expReward.claimFailed: This claim could not be completed. Reload the page, check the saved result, and try again.
expReward.savedWin: Victory saved. Confirm to choose one reward card.
expReward.fixedGiftFull: First-clear bonus: {card} is at the holding limit, so no additional copy is granted.
expReward.errorFullPool: All eligible rewards from this land are at the holding limit.
expReward.errorVictory: Finish the true-form stage and save the victory result first.
expReward.errorNoWin: There is no victory reward for this battle.
expReward.errorConfirmFull: Eligible cards are at the holding limit. Confirm to settle the result.
expReward.errorPool: Choose an eligible reward card from this land.
expReward.errorCardFull: This card is at the holding limit. Choose another card.
